# fairseq dependency

`fairseq` is an unmodified Git submodule of
<https://github.com/facebookresearch/fairseq>, pinned to the v0.12.2 release:

```text
4a388e64cd646ed7d7ad8de8fae55df2b8eea91d
```

Initialize the dependency from the repository root:

```bash
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

Install fairseq and its dependencies with `bash scripts/install.sh`.
